Game Overview

Candy Monsters is a monster title where feed the right candy to colorful monsters in this delightfully simple yet challenging game. Drag descending candies to match hues and satisfy each monster's craving. With 16 uniquely arranged levels and stars to earn, enjoy endless replayability as you aim for high scores and master the monster munch!
